title: Ligue des champions : Bayern-PSG, le retour des artistes pour une place en finale

title: What the Spirit shutdown means for budget travelers
summary: The average price of a domestic round-trip flight was $365 last week, which the travel website Kayak says is the highest so far this year. Kris Van Cleave explains how the closure of Spirit Airlines could impact costs and what budget travelers should know.

title: Prix des carburants : nouvelles mesures d'aides en France
summary: La Direction générale des finances publiques (DGFiP) a assuré mercredi que l'indemnité carburant de 50 euros destinée aux travailleurs modestes grands rouleurs, pour faire face à la flambée des prix du pétrole, serait mise en place via un formulaire sécurisé et avec des contrôles pour éviter les fraudes.

title: Driver accused of chasing child on bike down a sidewalk before attempting to break into a home
summary: A woman in Washington state is accused of trying to run over a child on an e-bike. Police say she later attempted to break into a home. The child was not harmed in the incident and the woman is now facing felony charges.
